review.assumptionsToDischarge: The actual j differential has its literal finite canonical divisor and degree twice the regular-differential dimension minus two. All local differential, residue and finite-coordinate prerequisites are derived. At poles and finite values its coefficient is the corresponding j-coordinate order minus one; other finite contributions are nonnegative. The actual three finite exceptional sets exist and their order sums are derived, so the field degree minus their cardinalities is a lower bound for canonical degree. The literal Fourier equivalence converts this into the original Gamma1 weight-two cusp-form dimension bound, with no canonical-degree, genus or local-order premise.
review.remaining: Bound the two finite elliptic fiber cardinalities by the already counted signed S/ST cyclic orbits, then combine with the audited real Manin upper bound.
